content.text:
Yes, it was worth investigating, and it has been fixed.

### Root Cause
In [docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts#L134), the theme configuration specifies `extends: DefaultTheme`. VitePress automatically executes `DefaultTheme.enhanceApp(ctx)` when extending the theme. 

However, `enhanceApp(ctx)` was also explicitly calling `DefaultTheme.enhanceApp?.(ctx)` inside its body, causing `DefaultTheme.enhanceApp` to run twice on startup. On the second invocation, VitePress attempted to re-register the built-in `Badge` component (`app.component("Badge", VPBadge)`), triggering the Vue runtime warning.

### Fix
Removed the redundant `DefaultTheme.enhanceApp?.(ctx)` call in [docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts#L137).
